column1: # mapping_set_description: "Identifier bridge from OMOP concept_ids to the LOINC codes they were loaded from. An OMOP concept_id is a surrogate key OHDSI assigns to a term taken verbatim from a source vocabulary; the CONCEPT row carries that term's native vocabulary_id and concept_code. Subject and object therefore denote the same concept and the predicate is skos:exactMatch. This is deliberately NOT the OHDSI 'Maps to' relation, which links non-standard to standard concepts and is lossy. Scope: the 93 LOINC-sourced concepts in the BDC priority measurement set (326 terms), which the BDC harmonized data model codes in OMOP. 9 of the 93 are LOINC Part (LP) codes rather than LOINC term codes; these are flagged in the comment column. All 93 concepts are valid (OMOP invalid_reason V) as of the resolution date. Generated automatically by a vocabulary-table join, hence semapv:UnspecifiedMatching - no manual curation was performed. LOINC codes and names are freely redistributable under the LOINC license; see https://loinc.org/license/."
